# GoTo Training

Manage GoTo Training organizers, trainings, registrations, reports, recordings, questionnaires, and submissions

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/go-to-training/.

## Actions

- **Create Training**: Schedule a training with one or more sessions and return its training key.
- **Create Training Registration**: Register one person for an entire training and return the registrant key, join URL, and confirmation URL.
- **Delete Training**: Delete a scheduled or completed GoTo Training training.
- **Delete Training Registration**: Cancel one unpaid training registration.
- **Download Training Recording** (read-only): Follow GoTo's recording redirect and return the downloaded recording as a file.
- **Get Training** (read-only): Get the schedule, organizers, registration settings, and metadata for one training.
- **Get Training Management URL** (read-only): Return the admin-portal URL for managing or launching a training.
- **Get Training Registrant** (read-only): Get complete registration details for one training registrant.
- **Get Training Start URL With Login** (read-only): Return a start URL that downloads and launches GoTo Training after the organizer logs in.
- **Get Training Start URL Without Login** (read-only): Return a host URL that downloads and launches GoTo Training without an organizer login.
- **List Session Attendees** (read-only): List registrants for one completed session, preserving every join/leave attendance interval and including no-shows with zero attended…
- **List Sessions by Date Range** (read-only): List completed training sessions for an organizer within a required date-time range.
- **List Training Organizers** (read-only): List the organizers assigned to one training on a sharing-enabled multi-user account.
- **List Training Poll Submissions** (read-only): Return one page of detailed poll answers, filterable by session, questionnaire key, and questionnaire version.
- **List Training Polls** (read-only): Return one page of poll questionnaires for a training, optionally limited to a session.
- **List Training Recordings** (read-only): List online recording metadata and download URLs for a training.
- **List Training Registrants** (read-only): List complete registration details for all registrants of a training.
- **List Training Sessions** (read-only): List all completed session details for one training.
- **List Training Survey Submissions** (read-only): Return one page of detailed survey answers, filterable by session, questionnaire key, and questionnaire version.
- **List Training Surveys** (read-only): Return one page of survey questionnaires for a training, optionally limited to a session.
- **List Training Test Submissions** (read-only): Return one page of detailed test answers, filterable by session, questionnaire key, and questionnaire version.
- **List Training Tests** (read-only): Return one page of test questionnaires for a training, optionally limited to a session.
- **List Trainings** (read-only): List an organizer's scheduled and ongoing trainings.
- **Update Training Name and Description**: Replace a scheduled training's name and optional description.
- **Update Training Organizers**: Replace all co-organizers assigned to a training and optionally email newly assigned organizers.
- **Update Training Registration Settings**: Set whether web registration and confirmation emails are disabled for a training.
- **Update Training Times**: Replace a training's time zone and complete session schedule, optionally email registrants and trainers, and return the exact notification…
